name: move_message
description:
Move an Outlook message to a different mail folder.

Use outlook_list_folders to find folder IDs, or use well-known folder names:
inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, archive, junkemail.

The message_id should come from outlook_search or outlook_get_message.

message_id.description: Message ID to move (from outlook_search or outlook_get_message)

destination_folder_id.description: Destination folder ID (from outlook_list_folders) or well-known name: inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, archive, junkemail
